comment: Pinned first-setup downloads. Every archive is verified by size and SHA-256 before extraction. Values were checked on 2026-09-12 against the archives used by the tested API28 runtime and the official repository manifests; the primary emulator pin was re-verified 2026-09-18.

emulator_select.note: runtime/sdk/emulator is what linux-launcher/runtime_paths.py and runner.py use. Components with role=alternate are never fetched by packaging/installer/install_jcs2.py unless --include-alternates is passed.

components.purpose: Launcher and settings panel interpreter with bundled Tcl/Tk 9.0; independent of host Python

license.notes: CPython PSF license; bundled Tcl/Tk (Tcl license) and statically linked X11 (MIT). Distribution metadata: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone

components.verification: 2026-09-12: exact archive extracted; tkinter TkVersion/TclVersion 9.0 imported under env -i; libtcl9tk9.0.so has no libX11 DT_NEEDED; highest GLIBC symbol 2.17
2026-09-12: versioned URL bytes equal the tested platform-tools-latest archive; adb identical to the tested runtime; sha1/size match repository2-1.xml
